name: Chronicle 2.0
tagline: AI-assisted presentations that actually look like you made them, not a robot.
problem: Most AI presentation tools produce generic, templated slides that look identical and lack brand personality. Teams waste time cleaning up AI-generated decks or reverting to manual slide creation. Chronicle 2.0 aims to deliver AI-powered efficiency while preserving design quality and visual originality.
useCases: Building polished investor or board decks without a dedicated designer
Creating branded sales presentations at speed without sacrificing visual quality
Generating internal strategy or roadmap decks that don't look AI-generated
Rapid iteration on pitch decks with AI assistance that respects layout intent
